name: esig-suite
description: Self-contained PDF e-signature SDK suite: @e-sig/core (engine + interfaces + signDocument), @e-sig/supabase (adapters), @e-sig/react (UI) + a Next.js starter.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @e-sig/core && npm run build -w @e-sig/supabase && npm run build -w @e-sig/react && npm run build -w @e-sig/uuaid && npm run build -w @e-sig/uaid-exch && npm run build -w @e-sig/worm && npm run build -w @e-sig/hsm-pkcs11 && npm run build -w @e-sig/assurance-gateway && npm run build -w @e-sig/mcp && npm run build -w @e-sig/pillar-bridge && npm run build -w @e-sig/cloud-provisioning
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @e-sig/core && npm run clean -w @e-sig/supabase && npm run clean -w @e-sig/react && npm run clean -w @e-sig/uuaid && npm run clean -w @e-sig/uaid-exch && npm run clean -w @e-sig/worm && npm run clean -w @e-sig/hsm-pkcs11 && npm run clean -w @e-sig/assurance-gateway && npm run clean -w @e-sig/mcp && npm run clean -w @e-sig/pillar-bridge && npm run clean -w @e-sig/cloud-provisioning
scripts.test: npm run test -w @e-sig/core && npm run test -w @e-sig/supabase && npm run test -w @e-sig/uuaid && npm run test -w @e-sig/uaid-exch && npm run test -w @e-sig/worm && npm run test -w @e-sig/hsm-pkcs11 && npm run test -w @e-sig/assurance-gateway && npm run test -w @e-sig/mcp && npm run test -w @e-sig/pillar-bridge && npm run test -w @e-sig/cloud-provisioning && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: vitest run scripts/ && npm test --prefix infra/waitlist
